title: Fix off-by-one bug in pagination
description: app/pagination.py has a failing test. page_bounds() returns the wrong end index - it is off by one, and it does not clamp the end to total. Fix the implementation so all tests pass. Do not change the tests.
acceptanceCriteria: page_bounds clamps the end index to total

seedFiles.app/pagination.py:
"""Pagination helpers."""


def page_bounds(page: int, per_page: int, total: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Return (start, end) indices for a 1-based page number."""
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    end = start + per_page + 1
    return start, end
